missionCases.objective: Release into the intended L1 trough sector A, clear the wall and leave the pipe supported after withdrawal
Release into the intended L1 trough sector A, clear the wall and leave the pipe supported after withdrawal
TELEOP: take one station-issued CORAL from the red station

reset.notApplicable: The pocket is fixed and the lip stays deployed: after the eject the robot is ready for the next station receive with no reset motion

endgame.notApplicable: The selected role parks; it does not climb

risks.risk: Installed tread stiffness is unmeasured; receive fails at 10 N/mm and is marginal at 20, and the drive stalls at 240 N/mm

benchTest.measure: Force to press a pipe 6 mm into each installed roller

risks.risk: Station receive: captive time, pass-through and escape on the real article

benchTest.measure: Powered feeds captive within 0.50 s of passing the flap, out of 40; disabled feeds kept, out of 10
benchTest.fail: any pipe through the nip or out of the inlet

risks.risk: Eject into the trough across stand-off and bus voltage; gearbox efficiency is assumed

benchTest.measure: Ejects captured and supported 2 s after withdrawal, out of 150 (5 stand-offs x 3 voltages x 10)
benchTest.fail: any cell <= 7/10 or a stall at 9 V

risks.risk: Carry custody under 1-8 g pulses and when leaving the station on the flap signal

benchTest.measure: Retained out of 60 powered and 40 disabled pulses; receive-and-go runs seated within 0.5 s, out of 10
benchTest.fail: any loss at 3 g or below

risks.risk: Two-trip cycle end to end; lateral dock scatter at the two sectors

benchTest.measure: Two-trip cycles with both pipes credited, out of 20; lateral dock error

risks.risk: Seated beam, flap and lip switches and the reef range interlock on real hardware

benchTest.measure: Displaced or missing pipes flagged within 50 ms; range error; eject commands accepted at 150 mm or beyond
benchTest.fail: any missed loss or any eject accepted beyond 150 mm

risks.risk: Lip sag, landing and frontal hit on the sprung stop

benchTest.measure: Tip sag under the pipe; permanent set after 50 pushes of 300 N and 5 wall hits at 1 m/s

risks.risk: Custody with the power off rests on the installed tread squeeze, which is unmeasured

benchTest.measure: Force to push a seated pipe through the unpowered nip; pipes kept nose-down for 60 s out of 5; kept through 8 g, 50 ms pulses out of 20

risks.risk: Loaded bus voltage on a weak pack while driving away is 9.12 V against the 9.0 V floor: 0.12 V of margin, on a lumped pack model

benchTest.measure: Lowest bus voltage logged over ten 3 m/s2 launches with the nip on hold, on a pack at the weak-condition resistance

risks.risk: Heavy inspection estimate 49.78 kg leaves 2.39 kg under the 52.16 kg limit, with 3.4 kg of joints and 5.5 kg of electrical parts carried as allowances

benchTest.measure: Inspection weight of the finished robot without bumpers and battery

risks.risk: With the worm removed nothing locks the nip when the robot is disabled or the main power is off
risks.closedBy: Trials show the tread squeeze alone holds: 24/24 required stop and hit cases retained with the power off, checked case carry-01-power-off-hit, premise power-off-custody; brake idle mode is set (design-findings.json PD17). The installed squeeze is bench gate G7

risks.risk: A second delivery into the section that already holds the first pipe fails in the trials
risks.closedBy: Premise lateral-dock-error holds each dock within 70 mm so the pipes land in different sectors (second-trip.json); the dock scatter itself is bench gate G4

risks.risk: The first draft needed a self-locking worm that held 4.10 N m, with no part selected
risks.closedBy: Replaced by a NEO 550 on a MAXPlanetary 36:1 with a powered hold; trials show the lock is not needed (design-findings.json PD3/PD6)

risks.risk: The first draft seat time moved from 0.15 to 0.69 s with an unmeasured contact stiffness
risks.closedBy: The robot leaves on the flap-closed signal; seat time no longer holds it (design-findings.json PD11)

risks.risk: The first draft lip stop and tip load were unsized and the lip leads the bumper by 24.5 mm
risks.closedBy: Sprung deployed stop sized in structure-checks.json L1-L9; the over-travel swing is checked case service-lip-over-travel

risks.risk: The first draft side-plate landing and bolts were unsized
risks.closedBy: Sized in structure-checks.json P1-P3 and S1-S2 (steel shafts)

risks.risk: The first draft left the G412 ruling open with no zone sensing
risks.closedBy: Ruling and reef range interlock in rules-rulings.json; premise g412-eject-interlock

risks.risk: The first draft had no station fixture and started the receive at an energy estimate
risks.closedBy: The station chute is a registered fixture and the receive trial starts on it
